video_title: Jaylen Brown has "Lamb Chop" Beef with Jayson Tatum | Danny Green on Top 5 NBA Rivalries

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown and Danny Green discuss the lack of real beef between them
quotes.excerpt: There's no beef. Jason comes from a wonderful family. We've accomplished some great things.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: Do you have any comment? Did you see what he said or any comment on what he said?

text_blocks.speaker: Jaylen Brown
text_blocks.text: I didn't see the full thing, but I saw that he said there's no beef. And I think he's right. There's no beef. Jason comes from a wonderful family. We've accomplished some great things. He's a hell of a basketball player. He got a great PR team. There's no beef, but it might be a little lamb chops and some gravy. You should stay ready at all times.
